text: Customers may request a return for eligible products according to the return policy. The product should meet the required return conditions, such as being within the allowed return period and in acceptable condition. Customers should follow the return instructions provided by the support team.

Customers who receive a damaged product should contact customer support and provide the order details. Photos or other evidence of the damage may be requested to help with the investigation. Support will review the case and provide the next steps according to the applicable policy.

Approved refunds are processed after the returned product has been received and checked when a return inspection is required. The refund is sent through the original payment method whenever possible. The time required for the refund to appear can depend on the payment provider.

Customers who receive an item different from what they ordered should contact customer support with their order details. Support may ask for photos of the received item and its packaging. The case will be reviewed, and the customer will be informed about the available resolution.

Customers who forget their password can reset it from the login page by selecting the password reset option. They must enter the email address linked to their account. A password reset link is then sent to that email address. The link allows the customer to create a new password.

Customers can view their previous orders from the order history section of their account. Order history may show information such as order numbers, purchased items, order dates, payment status, and delivery status. Customers can use this information when checking past purchases or contacting support.

Delivery may take longer than the estimated time because of weather, carrier issues, high order volumes, or other unexpected events. Customers should check their tracking information for the latest update. If the package remains delayed for an extended period, they can contact customer support for assistance.

Customers can create an account by entering their name, email address, and a password on the registration page. After submitting the form, they must verify their email address using the verification link sent to their inbox. The account becomes active after email verification is completed.

A payment may fail because of incorrect payment details, insufficient funds, an expired card, or a temporary issue with the payment provider. Customers should check their payment information and try again using an available payment method. If the problem continues, they can contact their payment provider or customer support.

Customers should update their delivery address before placing an order. If an order has already been placed, customers should contact support as soon as possible to ask whether the address can be changed. Address changes may not be possible after the order has been shipped.

Customers can place an order by selecting an available product, choosing the required quantity, and adding the item to their cart. Before submitting the order, customers should review the items, delivery address, and payment details. An order is created after the customer confirms the purchase.

After an order is successfully placed, customers receive an order confirmation containing the order details. The confirmation may include the order number, purchased items, delivery address, payment information, and estimated delivery details. Customers should keep the order number for future support requests.

A product may become unavailable when its current stock has been exhausted. Customers can check the product page for updated availability information. If a product is out of stock, customers may need to wait until new stock becomes available before placing an order.

Customers can update their account email address through the account settings when this option is available. The new email address may need to be verified before it becomes the primary contact address. Customers should have access to the new email account to complete verification.

Orders are shipped to the delivery address provided during checkout. Customers can check the shipping status using the tracking information provided after the order is dispatched. Delivery times can vary depending on the destination, shipping method, and carrier.

Customers can pay for orders using the payment methods available at checkout. The available methods may include credit cards, debit cards, digital wallets, or other supported options. Customers should confirm that their payment information is correct before completing the order.

Customers can contact support when they need help with an order, account, payment, delivery, or product issue. When contacting support, customers should provide relevant details such as their order number and a clear description of the problem. Providing complete information can help support review the issue more efficiently.

Customers can find product information on the product page. Product pages may include the product name, description, price, available options, specifications, and stock status. Customers should review this information before placing an order.

Customers can request an order cancellation before the order is shipped. Cancellation requests may not be possible after the order has entered the shipping process. Customers should contact support as soon as possible if they need to cancel an order.
